title: Vital Sign Comparison Between Lifelight and Standard of Care - Development
brief_summary: Patients and volunteers both with and without medical problems will be recruited; vital sign measurements are taken twice with normal equipment and while recording video data at the same time. The data collected will allow the Artificial Intelligence to develop the LifeLight algorithm to to improve measurement accuracy of its video data based vital signs monitor.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* I1. Sufficiently conversant in the English language to satisfy I3.
* I2. Able and willing to comply with all study requirements.
* I3. Able and willing to provide written informed consent to participate (including by parent or legal guardian if under 16 years old).

Exclusion Criteria:

* There are no exclusion criteria.
study_population: The inclusion/exclusion criteria is limited to the proposed intended use of the device, therefore only individuals, of any sex, over the age of 3 will be included in the study.
